title: Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank, Comisma Plan 10 Billion Yen Anime Production Fund
content: Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank and IP platform company Comisma have agreed in principle to establish an investment fund focused on anime production, targeting 10 billion yen (approximately US$63.4 million) in assets under management by the end of fiscal 2027.

content: The anime industry keeps expanding with exciting new releases, which is all the more reason why all the streaming platforms are trying their best to house old and new shows and movies as part of their library.

title: 12 Years Ago, Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Studio Released the Darkest Psychological Horror of All Time
content: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End is easily one of the biggest fantasy anime in recent years, but the animation studio behind it has been around for a while. Established in 1972, Madhouse is one of the oldest and most popular animation studios in the country.

title: Bleach’s Creator Almost Killed Off Orihime in the Manga’s Original Ending
content: Bleach would’ve had a tragic ending for Orihime Inoue if Tite Kubo had taken the initial route he had in mind for her. More than 22 years after its anime debut, Bleach has finally reached its conclusion with the Thousand-Year Blood War Arc.
author: ComicBook

title: Dragon Ball Super Artist Returns With New Look at Original Villain Amid Hiatus
content: The Dragon Ball Super manga has been on hiatus ever since Akira Toriyama’s death in March 2024. Written by Toriyama and illustrated by Toyotaro, the manga was released in 2015 as a sequel to the original story.
author: ComicBook

title: After 30 Years, Legendary Action Series to Return for New Spinoff Ahead of Anime Reboot
content: It’s only been a month since the anime reboot of Eat-Man was confirmed, and now it already has a streaming home. Via a press release, Crunchyroll confirmed acquiring streaming rights to the anime when it premieres.
author: ComicBook

title: Sanrio's Kuromi Character Gets 1st Film in 2027
content: Sanrio announced on Saturday that its Kuromi character will star in her first film, which the distributor GAGA open in Japan next year. The company made the announcement with an English-subtitled video message from Kuromi on Halloween, which is also Kuromi's birthday.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll’s Darkest Fall 2026 Anime Celebrates Halloween With Creator’s Spooky Tribute
content: Crunchyroll ‘s darkest Fall 2026 anime continues to emerge as one of the spookiest series of the season, and its creator is embracing the same vibe with a special tribute to celebrate Halloween. The end of October brings an exciting and spooky atmosphere, adding a different kind of energy.
